readme:
# DDPO 高斯转移密度与逐步 PPO

## 1. 问题

计算高斯去噪转移的联合 log 密度，并实现终点优势广播的 clipped PPO 损失。

使用固定方差高斯转移实现 DDPO 的策略目标，包含在线小型 bandit；不加载扩散骨干。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
\ell=-\frac12\sum_d[(a_d-\mu_d)^2/s^2+2\log s+\log(2\pi)],\quad L=-\operatorname{mean}_{b,t}\min(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}}A_b,\operatorname{clip}(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}},1-e,1+e)A_b).
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

```python
gaussian_log_prob(mean: Tensor, actions: Tensor, std: Tensor) -> Tensor
```
```python
ddpo_loss(current: Tensor, old: Tensor, advantages: Tensor, clip: float) -> Tensor
```

每个转移的坐标共同构成一个动作，因此先对特征维求 log 密度之和。旧策略和采样动作保持固定。逐步概率比乘终点优势，对正负优势分别由 min 选择保守分支。

## 4. 本题约定

gaussian_log_prob: means/actions (B,T,D), std (T,) strictly positive; return (B,T) summing D. ddpo_loss: current/old (B,T), advantages (B,), 0<clip<1. Average B,T.

Gaussian actions and std are detached; current means differentiate. PPO old log probabilities and advantages are detached. Very large unfavorable log ratios may overflow; finite tested ratios stay within the declared numerical domain |current-old|<=40.

## 5. 交互图与实验

实验使用你提交的函数。图中各点来自实际运行结果。

A scalar Gaussian policy with standard deviation 0.6 draws 128 fresh actions per update; 60 PPO gradient updates optimize a quadratic terminal reward toward target 1.

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

加入按 prompt 维护的奖励统计量，而不是跨 prompt 共享一个基线。

[Training Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13301) · Section 4.3 Eq. (6), importance-sampled DDPO; Appendix D.1
notes:
# 题解与常见错误

每个转移的坐标共同构成一个动作，因此先对特征维求 log 密度之和。旧策略和采样动作保持固定。逐步概率比乘终点优势，对正负优势分别由 min 选择保守分支。

$$
\ell=-\frac12\sum_d[(a_d-\mu_d)^2/s^2+2\log s+\log(2\pi)],\quad L=-\operatorname{mean}_{b,t}\min(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}}A_b,\operatorname{clip}(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}},1-e,1+e)A_b).
$$

Gaussian actions and std are detached; current means differentiate. PPO old log probabilities and advantages are detached. Very large unfavorable log ratios may overflow; finite tested ratios stay within the declared numerical domain |current-old|<=40.

不能将特征维 log 密度取平均，也不能把整条轨迹比率相乘后再截断。负优势下 clip 下界限制过度降低概率的收益。

测试依据：独立高斯标量密度、正负截断手算、score梯度、冻结采样、复制时间步的归约不变性。

## 实验标定

固定种子 42，CPU float64，直接梯度下降；无需数据下载。以下是参考解实际测量，不是预设轨迹。 PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.08 (60 updates).

```json
{"final_error": 1.7610391745268231e-06, "initial_error": 1.0, "updates": 60}
```

验收阈值见 `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`；基线为训练前参数的实际输出。

en.title: DDPO Gaussian Transition Densities and Stepwise PPO
en.readme:
# DDPO Gaussian Transition Densities and Stepwise PPO

## 1. Problem

Compute joint Gaussian denoising-transition log densities and clipped PPO with terminal advantages broadcast over steps.

Implement the DDPO objective for fixed-variance Gaussian transitions and an online toy bandit, without a diffusion backbone.

## 2. Core equations

$$
\ell=-\frac12\sum_d[(a_d-\mu_d)^2/s^2+2\log s+\log(2\pi)],\quad L=-\operatorname{mean}_{b,t}\min(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}}A_b,\operatorname{clip}(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}},1-e,1+e)A_b).
$$

## 3. From equations to code

```python
gaussian_log_prob(mean: Tensor, actions: Tensor, std: Tensor) -> Tensor
```
```python
ddpo_loss(current: Tensor, old: Tensor, advantages: Tensor, clip: float) -> Tensor
```

An action consists of all feature coordinates, so sum log densities over features. Hold sampled actions and the old policy fixed. Multiply each transition ratio by the terminal advantage and choose the conservative clipped branch with minimum.

## 4. Contract

gaussian_log_prob: means/actions (B,T,D), std (T,) strictly positive; return (B,T) summing D. ddpo_loss: current/old (B,T), advantages (B,), 0<clip<1. Average B,T.

Gaussian actions and std are detached; current means differentiate. PPO old log probabilities and advantages are detached. Very large unfavorable log ratios may overflow; finite tested ratios stay within the declared numerical domain |current-old|<=40.

## 5. Visualization and experiment

The experiment calls your submitted functions; plotted points are measured results.

A scalar Gaussian policy with standard deviation 0.6 draws 128 fresh actions per update; 60 PPO gradient updates optimize a quadratic terminal reward toward target 1.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions

Add per-prompt running reward statistics instead of a single global baseline.

[Training Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13301) · Section 4.3 Eq. (6), importance-sampled DDPO; Appendix D.1
en.notes:
# Solution reasoning and pitfalls

An action consists of all feature coordinates, so sum log densities over features. Hold sampled actions and the old policy fixed. Multiply each transition ratio by the terminal advantage and choose the conservative clipped branch with minimum.

$$
\ell=-\frac12\sum_d[(a_d-\mu_d)^2/s^2+2\log s+\log(2\pi)],\quad L=-\operatorname{mean}_{b,t}\min(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}}A_b,\operatorname{clip}(e^{\ell-\ell_{old}},1-e,1+e)A_b).
$$

Gaussian actions and std are detached; current means differentiate. PPO old log probabilities and advantages are detached. Very large unfavorable log ratios may overflow; finite tested ratios stay within the declared numerical domain |current-old|<=40.

Do not average feature log densities or clip a product of full-trajectory ratios. For negative advantages the lower clip bound limits gains from excessively reducing action probability.

Test basis: Scalar Gaussian densities, signed clipping oracle, score gradients, frozen samples and timestep-duplication invariance.

## Experiment calibration

Seed 42, CPU float64, direct gradient descent, no downloaded data. Values below were measured from the reference, not a preset trajectory. PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.08 (60 updates).

```json
{"final_error": 1.7610391745268231e-06, "initial_error": 1.0, "updates": 60}
```

Acceptance thresholds are in `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`; the baseline is the measured output before training.
